# ASCII cell-run golden fixture
# Unicode 15.0.0 — UAX #29 grapheme clusters / UAX #11 widths
#
# Format: description | utf8 bytes (hex, space-sep) | tab_width
#         → total_cells spans (offset:len:width:kind)
# Kind codes: T=text, C=combining, TAB=tab, CTL=control, INV=invalid_utf8
#
# All ASCII printable characters are narrow (1 cell each).
# Each character is its own grapheme cluster (no combining extensions).

# Single ASCII printable character
single_space      | 20          | 4 → 1  | 0:1:1:T
single_A          | 41          | 4 → 1  | 0:1:1:T
single_z          | 7A          | 4 → 1  | 0:1:1:T
single_tilde      | 7E          | 4 → 1  | 0:1:1:T

# "hello" — 5 narrow characters, 5 spans
hello             | 68 65 6C 6C 6F | 4 → 5 | 0:1:1:T 1:1:1:T 2:1:1:T 3:1:1:T 4:1:1:T

# Empty input
empty             | (none)      | 4 → 0  | (none)

# Mixed ASCII
abc               | 61 62 63    | 4 → 3  | 0:1:1:T 1:1:1:T 2:1:1:T
